domains.name: Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI)
domains.description: Source-linked CTI field guide covering intelligence requirements, collection, analysis, ATT&CK, actor research, sharing, hunting, and detection.
domains.card_description: Turning raw data about adversaries into decisions: the intelligence cycle, ATT&CK, the Diamond Model, actor tracking, and how CTI feeds detection engineering.

domains.name: Red Team & Offensive Security
domains.description: A 14-module red-team field guide covering authorization, recon, web, cloud, identity, clients, AI/MCP, labs, validation, evidence, and reporting.
domains.card_description: Adversary emulation, penetration testing, and exploit tradecraft: recon, initial access, privilege escalation, lateral movement, and reporting.

domains.name: Blue Team & Defensive Security
domains.description: Blue Team field guide covering SOC operations, telemetry, detection engineering, threat hunting, cloud defense, incident response, AI, and validation.
domains.card_description: SOC operations, detection engineering, threat hunting, and incident handling: the discipline of finding and stopping what red team simulates.

domains.name: Vulnerability Research & Exploit Development
domains.description: Vulnerability-research guide covering safe labs, static and dynamic analysis, fuzzing, exploitability, coordinated disclosure, remediation, and AI.
domains.card_description: Finding and understanding software flaws: fuzzing, memory corruption classes, static/dynamic analysis, and responsible disclosure.

domains.name: Malware Analysis & Reverse Engineering
domains.description: Malware-analysis and reverse-engineering guide covering safe triage, disassembly, debugging, unpacking, memory, Android, YARA, AI, and defensive handoff.
domains.card_description: Static and dynamic triage, unpacking, disassembly, and behavioral analysis of malicious code, from first-look triage to full reverse engineering.

domains.name: Secure Code & Application Security
domains.description: Application-security guide covering threat modeling, identity, authorization, APIs, cryptography, supply chains, testing, AI systems, and remediation.
domains.card_description: Secure design, threat modeling, identity, authorization, API and browser controls, supply-chain assurance, AI-system boundaries, testing, release evidence, and remediation.

domains.name: Digital Forensics & Incident Response (DFIR)
domains.description: DFIR field guide covering readiness, triage, evidence integrity, endpoint, memory, network, cloud, identity, containment, recovery, reporting, and AI.
domains.card_description: Incident readiness, defensible evidence handling, endpoint, disk, memory, network, cloud, identity and malware forensics, timeline reconstruction, containment, recovery, reporting, labs, and controlled AI assistance.

domains.name: Cloud Security
domains.description: Cloud-security guide covering shared responsibility, IAM, networks, data, IaC, containers, Kubernetes, detection, incident response, SaaS, and AI.
domains.card_description: Shared responsibility, landing zones, human and workload IAM, network and data protection, IaC, containers, Kubernetes, multi-cloud detection and response, SaaS, suppliers, and AI workloads.

domains.name: Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC)
domains.description: Cybersecurity GRC guide covering governance, scenario-based risk, NIST CSF 2.0, controls, audit evidence, suppliers, privacy, resilience, and AI.
domains.card_description: Cyber governance, scenario-based risk, frameworks, policy and control design, evidence and audit, legal and contractual obligations, suppliers, privacy, resilience, metrics, product assurance, and AI governance.

domains.name: OSINT & Reconnaissance
domains.description: A 14-module OSINT field guide to ethical collection, infrastructure discovery, media verification, threat research, AI assistance, evidence, and reporting.
domains.card_description: Authorized and ethical collection, search and archives, DNS/RDAP/certificates, internet exposure, applications, organizations, public code, media verification, threat infrastructure, automation, AI assistance, evidence, and reporting.
